steps.name: script
script: TIMEFORMAT='TIMING docker-info %R'; time docker info --format 'docker info: storage driver {{.Driver}}, cgroup v{{.CgroupVersion}} ({{.CgroupDriver}}), registry mirrors {{.RegistryConfig.Mirrors}}'

printf 'package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello from a flintlock-runner MicroVM") }
' >main.go
TIMEFORMAT='TIMING go-build %R'; time CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o hello .

printf 'FROM docker.io/library/alpine:3.22
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates
COPY hello /usr/local/bin/hello
ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/hello"]
' >Dockerfile
TIMEFORMAT='TIMING buildx-build %R'; time docker buildx build --load -t builddemo:latest .
for u in guest-agent flr-registry-mirror containerd docker; do echo "BOOT $u $(( $(systemctl show -p ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic --value $u.service) / 1000 )) ms"; done
